## Geolocator/Benchmark

Name and description of the geolocator or benchmark to evaluate against.

## Availability

- [ ] Publicly available model/API
- [ ] Paper with reproducible methodology
- [ ] Commercial service (requires API key)
- [ ] Other (describe)

## References

Links to papers, code repositories, or documentation.

## Expected Difficulty

How challenging do you expect this geolocator to be?

- [ ] Easy (metadata-based or simple retrieval)
- [ ] Medium (CNN-based classification)
- [ ] Hard (VLM with reasoning)
- [ ] Very Hard (ensemble or human-assisted)

## Priority

Why should we prioritize this evaluation?

## Additional Context

Any other relevant information.
